title: Repeated Late Funding: Questions and Answers for the Paystride Payroll Card Program Desk
content:
**Does an employer's recent late funding change a new late funding fee on its Paystride Payroll Card Program?**
Yes. The late-fee charge is multiplied for repeated lateness, counting the late funding fees debited in the late-fee look-back less the late funding fees credited in it, the fee being figured not yet counted:

- two or more — by 1.5;
- exactly one — by 1.25;
- none — the charge is not multiplied for repeated lateness.

**What is the late-fee look-back?** The late-fee look-back holds the funding entries dated today or earlier that lie fewer than three whole months before today, whole months being counted as the difference in calendar months less one when today's day of the month is smaller than the entry's.

**Does the fee being figured count itself?** No; only late funding fees already on the ledger count.

**Does a credited late funding fee count?** Each late funding fee credited in the look-back is taken off the count of those debited in it.

**Hypothetical cases (today being 12 November)**

| Late funding fees debited in the look-back | Credited in it | Count | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|---|
| one dated 13 August, one dated 3 November | none | 2 | 1.5 |
| one dated 12 August, one dated 3 November | none | 1, since 12 August lies three whole months back | 1.25 |
| one dated 3 November | one dated 5 November | none | none |

A hypothetical late-fee charge of 58.40 multiplied by 1.5 is 87.60, and by 1.25 is 73.00.
